name: knowledgegraph-laya
description: Bounded Neo4j evidence selection and local feedback walks with resident Laya or Decision 2.0 workers.

interface.longDescription: Select reviewed relationships and follow bounded local graph paths while preserving source evidence and conditions. Uses the KnowledgeGraph CLI with Laya or an optional Decision 2.0 worker.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find the source-linked relationship and its conditions for this paper excerpt.
